editorial.blurb: Nigerian Kitchen brings authentic West African comfort to Uptown Chicago with homemade-tasting stews, generous portions of fresh protein, and well-seasoned staples.
editorial.insiderTip: Order through DoorDash but plan for close to an hour wait; the quality and hot arrival justify the patience. Ask for added spice if you prefer heat — it's available upon request.
